title: Instead of a birthday card, Claude and I built her an entire HD-2D adventure game
author: rubenrb02
selftext:
My friend's birthday was coming up, so instead of a card I made her a game.

She's a polar bear who travels through 8 cities to get back the 8 "little eyes" that hold the world's joy, with a different minigame in each one. Then, right at the end, an evil broccoli steals them all She has to beat him in 8 boss fights to win them back... and then a surprise birthday party is waiting for her.

Built with Claude Code and raw WebGL2. No engine, and even the art is generated in code.

Happy to answer questions!

comments.author: BotaFitne
comments.body: It feel really nice and cozy!
